page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a catchword at the lower right. No margin notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top left.

main_text.l: quot negotiis litterariis, opus hoc, quod
lius, qui Syriaca & Arabica Latine ver-
tit, lentum nimium, & in labore remis-
sum animum annus unus, & alter, atque
temporis spatio ad exitum festinat edi-
eum ab aliis negotiis inducias obtinuis-
me remissurum, idem etiam R. Patri Goe-
zaldo de codice tuo significo, eamque ut
de salute tua mihi rescribat rogo. Ha-

page.notes: The catchword "bes," is printed at the lower right and completes the word "Habes," which begins the line "Ha-". "Peresciurn" is uncertain; the printed form may be a misreading of a proper name. The "u/v" spelling was normalised (qvot to quot, qvod to quod, qvadrimestri to quadrimestri, and similar). Æ is kept as printed. The text is clear throughout, with no damage or illegible words.
